dogecoin.text: Fast forward to 2025, and the joke’s not so funny anymore. With a market cap hovering in the billions and a fanbase that includes Elon Musk, Dogecoin ($DOGE) is no longer just a meme coin—it’s a cultural and financial phenomenon. How do these things happen? Great to know this.

read this Dogecoin started as a punchline a crypto$ born in 2013 from a meme featuring a wide-eyed Shiba Inu and a flood of broken English captions. Developers, Billy Markus & Jackson Palmer, wanted to mock the crypto hype of the early 2010s.
